scripts.build:free: env VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=false tsc --noEmit && env VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=false vite build
scripts.build:premium: env VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=true tsc --noEmit && env VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=true vite build
scripts.build:android: VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=true CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 tsc --noEmit && VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=true CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 vite build
scripts.build:android:free: VITE_ENABLE_ADMOB=true VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=false VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=false CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 tsc --noEmit && VITE_ENABLE_ADMOB=true VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=false VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=false CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 vite build
scripts.build:android:pro: VITE_ENABLE_ADMOB=false VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=true VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=false CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 tsc --noEmit && VITE_ENABLE_ADMOB=false VITE_ENABLE_VOICE_ACTOR=true VITE_ADMOB_TEST_MODE=false CAPACITOR_BUILD=1 vite build
scripts.cap:sync: bun run build:android && cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:free: bun run build:android:free && cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:pro: bun run build:android:pro && cap sync android
scripts.apk:release:free: bun run cap:sync:free && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.apk:release:pro: bun run cap:sync:pro && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.cap:run: bun run build:android && cap sync android && cap run android --no-sync
scripts.cap:run:free: bun run build:android:free && cap sync android && cap run android --no-sync
scripts.cap:run:pro: bun run build:android:pro && cap sync android && cap run android --no-sync
